notifications.receivedBody:
Hello *{patientName}*,

We have received your booking and it is currently awaiting confirmation.

📋 *Booking Details:*
• Service: {serviceName}
• Date: {date}
• Time: {time} ({duration} minutes)

We will send a notification once your booking is confirmed.
notifications.confirmedBody:
Hello *{patientName}*,

Your booking has been *confirmed*. Please arrive according to the following schedule:

📋 *Booking Details:*
• Service: {serviceName}
• Date: {date}
• Time: {time} ({duration} minutes)

Please arrive 10 minutes prior to your schedule.
